name: NASA / University of Cincinnati IMS Bearing Dataset
description: Run-to-failure accelerometer recordings from four Rexnord ZA-2115 bearings on a shared shaft.

acquisition.note: Official IMS sampling rate is 20 kHz. Each snapshot is 20,480 samples (1.024 s). Some papers cite 20,480 Hz; that is treated as incorrect here.

bearing.note: Geometry and 2000 RPM shaft speed come from the IMS readme. Characteristic frequencies (FTF/BPFO/BPFI/BSF) are computed from these inputs, not measured from the waveform.

envelope_band.note: 1-3 kHz resonance band selected from envelope experiments on inner-race and outer-race late-life files. Not a dataset specification.

failed_bearings_note: Documented IMS damage: T1-B3 inner race, T1-B4 rolling element, T2-B1 outer race, T3-B3 outer race.
trajectory_split_note: Split by (test_id, bearing_id), never by shuffled rows. Train includes two documented failures (T1-B3 inner race and T2-B1 outer race) so supervised models see more than one fault type. Val keeps T1-B4 (roller). Test holds out Test 3 (T3-B3 outer race + T3-B4 healthy). Selection/calibration use validation only; test is reporting-only.

targets.note: Artifact threshold flags near-zero Test 2/3 shutdown files. RUL endpoint is last non-artifact timestamp on documented failed bearings (IMS has no exact physical failure time). Isolation Forest baseline is the first 20% of operational rows per trajectory.

temporal.note: Normal cadence is ~10 min. Test 1 has pauses up to ~148 h. Deltas/rates after gaps > 2 h are zeroed.
